observations.text: Hero: 'Your Creative OS' — 'TapNow is the best way to create with AI Agents. Orchestrate text, image, audio, and video models. Zero friction.'
Hero embeds a live React Flow demo canvas (nodes Reference → Image Generation → Poem → Video Generation, left tool rail, prompt bar 'Describe your idea or select nodes for context...').
'Get started for free' runs navToTap() → https://app.tapnow.ai/home (opens outside the tab; the app URL is embedded in JSON-LD).

Sections (marketing screenshots/videos only): 'Your AI Executive Director' (zero manual context feeding, agent drives script, predicts next scene, enforces shot-by-shot consistency), Lens Combo (camera bodies, lenses, focal lengths, apertures), Multi-angle camera control (cube), Studio lighting control, Video object replacement, Global frontier models (Veo, Kling, Luma, Sora, Midjourney, GPT Image, Hailuo, Jimeng, Vidu, Flux, Pixverse, Grok, Gemini), TapNow Community (clone/remix templates).
Trust logos: Alibaba, Google Ads/Cloud, TikTok, YouTube, ByteDance, Tencent, WPP, Honda, The Trade Desk, BlueFocus, Yeahmobi, ANTA, AUKEY.
